title: I made my first Skyrim mod using AI tools — a functional toilet in Whiterun
author: Heavy-Ad-9948
selftext:
This is one of my first Skyrim mods, and also an experiment in seeing how far I could get using AI as part of the development workflow.

The result is Retrete VIP, a functional bathroom/toilet added to Whiterun in Skyrim Special Edition.

I used AI tools throughout the process to help with things like 3D asset creation, textures, scripting/modding guidance and troubleshooting. I then integrated everything into Skyrim, tested it in-game and iterated on the problems that appeared.

I’m not a professional programmer or 3D artist, so one of the main goals of this project was to see whether AI could make Skyrim mod development more accessible to someone willing to test, learn and operate the tools.

The mod itself is intentionally humorous: Skyrim has houses, castles, inns and kitchens, but apparently nobody ever needed a bathroom.

I’m interested in improving this workflow and eventually making more complex Skyrim mods with AI assistance.

If anyone here works with AI-assisted 3D, Blender, game modding or automated development pipelines, I’d be interested in hearing what you would improve.

Nexus Mods: https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrimspecialedition/mods/193140
